title: introduce-microcost-sleuth-coalescer-and-quant-fallback
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a tenant-aware microcost coalescer that prefers compact prefill shapes and a safe quantization fallback path. No API changes. Opt-in via feature flag 'microcost.sleuth_enabled'.
description:
Motivation: Customers running mixed workloads were seeing inconsistent unit economics across tenants during bursty periods. Existing heuristics favored latency SLOs but did not surface conservative presets when cost budgets were tight. This PR introduces the Microcost Sleuth Coalescer: a lightweight runtime component that synthesizes compact prefill candidates, ranks them by estimated unit-cost delta and quality risk, and applies a safe quantization fallback only when tenant budgets or SKU constraints recommend it.

What this PR does (single string): - New runtime actor `microcost_sleuth` that watches per-tenant cost signals and recent sample traces. - Compact prefill generator: proposes alternative prefill shapes (prefix trimming, grouped prompts) and computes a simulated token-cost delta using the cost-model shim. - Quant fallback orchestrator: when compact prefill cannot meet budget targets, the orchestrator selects a compatible quant-profile (int8/llm-int8-like presets) with a degradation budget and attaches a `graceful_degradation` tag to the request for downstream evaluators. - Telemetry: adds prefilling/coalescer metrics (sleuth.proposals, sleuth.applied, sleuth.fallback_rate) and event logs to aid auditing. - Config: a tenant-level opt-in flag `microcost.sleuth_enabled`, plus global guardrails to prevent aggressive fallback under SLA-critical labels. - Integration tests and dry-run simulation CLI that can replay a day's traces and produce an econometrics report.

Rollout plan: Feature-flagged rollout. 1) enable dry-run for a subset of tenants to collect proposal quality metrics; 2) gradually enable apply-mode for non-SLA tenants; 3) monitor sleuth.fallback_rate, unit_cost_percentile (p50/p95) and quality regressions reported by evals.

Testing: Unit tests for proposal ranking, integration tests for end-to-end flow (generator -> orchestrator -> serving). Added a synthetic workload scenario to perf-canary that validates no latency regression above 3ms median for compact proposals. CI run included smoke, unit, integration, and perf checks.

Backward compatibility/Impact: No public API surface changes. Behavioral change is opt-in. Fallback uses only validated quant-profiles that are in the existing quant registry; no new quant kernels are introduced.

Related work: ENG-8421 (tenant budget signals), ENG-8438 (compact prefill proposals), SUP-4121 (support request for runaway tenant costs).
commits: feat: add microcost_sleuth actor and initial proposal generator
test: add integration and dry-run simulation tests
docs: document feature flag and rollout playbook
chore: telemetry metric mappings and dashboards
review_comments: Sanjay Patel: Overall approach looks good. Can you add a short-circuit so that compact proposals are not generated for requests with explicit 'do_not_trim' metadata?
Maya Chen (author): Added short-circuit in coalescer; updated tests to assert no proposals for 'do_not_trim' requests.
Luca Rossi: The fallback selection uses a static degradation budget of 5%. Can we expose this as a tenant override and add a safety cap?
Maya Chen (author): Made degradation_budget a tenant-overridable field with a global safety_cap (default 8%). Updated config and documented behavior.
Ava Martinez: Telemetry looks useful but we should ensure SLI dashboards do not double-count replayed dry-runs. Please tag dry-run events and filter them in dashboards.
Maya Chen (author): Marked dry-run events with 'sleuth_mode:dry_run' and updated metrics.yaml to include drop filters.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag 'microcost.sleuth_enabled' per tenant via Console > Runtime Defaults. Default is OFF. Monitor sleuth.fallback_rate and unit_cost_p95 for first 72h after enabling.
post_merge_tasks: add tenant override UI in Console (product)
schedule a 1-week dry-run cohort and gather proposal/quality metrics
backfill telemetry tag for last 7 days in staging to calibrate thresholds
